text:
Predicates:
Season(s) ::: s is a season.
Favorite(x, s) ::: s is the favorite season of x.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
WantLongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
LoveMost(x, s) ::: x loves s the most.
Premises:
Season(spring) ∧ Season(summer) ∧ Season(fall) ∧ Season(winter) ∧ ¬(spring = summer) ∧ ¬(spring = fall) ∧ ¬(spring = winter) ∧ ¬(summer = fall) ∧ ¬(summer = winter) ∧ ¬(fall = winter) ::: There are four seasons in a year: Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WantLongVacation(x) → LoveMost(x, summer)) ::: All students who want to have a long vacation love summer the most.
Favorite(emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
Favorite(mia, s) → s ≠ summer ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
WantLongVacation(james) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.
Conclusion:
Favorite(mia, spring) ::: Mia's favorite season is spring.
